title: Bug Fixes — System Audit Q1-2026
description: Bugs identified during full-system audit of the Cordum control plane. Covers concurrency issues, error handling gaps, security defaults, and resource leaks across gateway, scheduler, workflow engine, infra, and deployment configs.
architectureNotes: Priority order: CRITICAL (security/panics) → HIGH (data loss/races) → MEDIUM (robustness). Each task should include a regression test. Do not change public API signatures.
epicRails: All fixes must include unit/integration tests
Do not change public API signatures
Use defer cancel() pattern for all context.WithTimeout calls
